fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-01-01, around 21:05, items including a bicycle and some tools were taken from an unattended premises at Neithal Garden Apartment Complex, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-01-01. Ramya Bai submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000232. A person named Mohan Ramasamy, associated with the number 9000000458, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Nandha Muthu (9000000322), described as a person who arranged the contact, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, CCTV, apartment complex, suspect, associate, photograph, mobile number
